steps.direction: Before anyone is in, hold the phone high and close to the bench, then lean back slowly to show the whole room.

captions.script: Here are the benches, the stove, and how many people fit.
This is the hot room, and yes, it is as warm as it looks.

steps.title: What to bring
steps.position: In the changing area, at a bench
steps.direction: Phone straight above the bench. Lay out what you brought one item at a time (towel, flip-flops, water bottle).

captions.script: Here is what I brought, one thing at a time.
Pack these and you are ready for your first session.

steps.title: Step in
steps.position: Outside the sauna door, phone propped low
steps.direction: Prop the phone low on a bench outside the door and walk through it. Film only yourself, and only when the room is free.

captions.script: Okay, here we go, into the heat.
Round one. Here is how long I stay in the heat.

steps.title: How it felt
steps.position: In the rest area, after the session
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level in the rest area. Say how the session felt, nothing more.
steps.prompter: Here is how many rounds I did, and I feel so calm.

captions.script: Here is how many rounds I did, and I feel so calm.
First time verdict: hot, quiet, and I would come back again.

steps.title: Session price
steps.position: At the reception, by the price list
steps.direction: Film the price list and move in slowly to the session you had.

captions.script: Here is what one session costs, and what it includes.
Here is the price list, book your first session on Loca.

templates.title: One move from the coach
templates.summary: The coach shows one beginner move, the stance up close, you copy it, and the class it comes from.

steps.title: The move
steps.position: A few metres from the coach, in an empty corner
steps.direction: Phone low and still, film the coach doing the move once at full speed (a swing, a squat, a flow).

captions.script: One move every beginner should learn, straight from the coach.
This is the move the coach picked for beginners.

steps.title: Meet the coach
steps.position: Facing the coach, at eye level
steps.direction: Back camera on the coach's head and shoulders, front camera on you. Say what you are about to learn.
steps.prompter: This is my coach, and they have one move every beginner should learn.

captions.script: This is my coach, and they have one move every beginner should learn.
Lesson one from the coach, and here is why it matters.

steps.title: The setup
steps.position: Standing over the coach's feet or hands
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight down over the coach's feet or grip while they set up. Keep it still.

captions.script: Here is the setup, step by step, before the move.
Watch the setup closely. Here is how the coach does it.

steps.title: My turn
steps.position: On the same spot, phone propped on the floor
steps.direction: Prop the phone low so only you are in frame, then do the move three times.

captions.script: My turn, and it looks a lot easier when the coach does it.
Trying it myself, slower, with the coach watching my feet.

steps.title: How it felt
steps.position: Same spot, after the reps
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level. Say how it felt and what you will remember.
steps.prompter: A few reps of that and I finally get why people love this class.

captions.script: A few reps of that and I finally get why people love this class.
Worth learning properly, I would sign up for the full class.

steps.title: The class
steps.position: At the class schedule
steps.direction: Film the schedule and move in slowly to the coach's class and its time.

captions.script: This move is from their class, here is when it runs.
Book the full class on Loca, times are on the board.

templates.title: Treatment booking
templates.summary: A massage, facial or IV bar visit: the empty room, the menu with prices, the walkthrough and how it felt.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: At the treatment room door, before the session
steps.direction: Start with the lens behind the door frame or curtain, then step past it so the empty room appears.

captions.script: This is the room for my first treatment here, and it is spotless.
Booked a session, and this is where it happens.

steps.title: The menu
steps.position: At the reception, by the treatment menu
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the menu and point to the treatment you booked and its price.

captions.script: Here is what I booked and what it costs.
The full menu with prices, and here is the one I picked.

steps.title: The walkthrough
steps.position: Facing the practitioner, before the session
steps.direction: Back camera on the practitioner as they explain, front camera on you. Say what they told you.
steps.prompter: They walked me through the whole session before we even started.

captions.script: They walked me through the whole session before we even started.
They told me exactly what happens before we started.

steps.title: During
steps.position: On the table, phone propped on a shelf above
steps.direction: Prop the phone looking straight down at your hands or feet on the towel. Film only yourself.

captions.script: Phone down, eyes closed, and this time is mine.
Quiet time, and nobody asking me anything.

steps.title: How it felt
steps.position: In the lounge or at the door, after
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length. Say how you felt walking out, nothing more.
steps.prompter: Walked out slow and quiet, I did not want to talk to anyone.

captions.script: Walked out slow and quiet, I did not want to talk to anyone.
After the session I feel calm, and I am booking the next one.

steps.title: Find it
steps.position: At the entrance, by the name plate
steps.direction: Start close on the name plate or sign, then lean back slowly so the entrance appears.

captions.script: Book this treatment through Loca, the price is on screen.
This is the entrance, so look for the sign.

templates.title: First appointment
templates.summary: A first visit to a clinic: the door, the empty waiting room, the person who treats you and the first-visit price.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.position: Outside, a few steps from the clinic door
steps.direction: Phone at chest height, walk slowly up to the door until it fills the screen.

captions.script: My first appointment here, and I will be honest, I was nervous.
Trying a new clinic, and this is the door.

steps.title: Waiting room
steps.position: Inside, by the waiting area, when it is empty
steps.direction: Only when nobody is waiting: start behind a plant or the door frame, then step past it to show the room.

captions.script: Here is the waiting room, and how long I waited.
This is the waiting room, clean and calm.

steps.title: Meet them
steps.position: Next to the clinician, before the appointment
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level with the clinician beside you, both in frame. Keep screens and files out of shot.
steps.prompter: Meeting the person doing my first appointment, I came with a lot of questions.

captions.script: Meeting the person doing my first appointment, I came with a lot of questions.
This is who will see me today, and I have my questions ready.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: In the treatment room, before you sit down
steps.direction: Back camera on the clinician pointing to the chair or one piece of kit, front camera on you. Move in slowly.
steps.prompter: They showed me each tool before using it, which helped a lot.

captions.script: They showed me each tool before using it, which helped a lot.
Everything was explained first, which matters when you are nervous.

steps.title: First visit price
steps.position: At the reception, by the price list
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the first-visit price on the list or leaflet. Keep the screen and any names out.

captions.script: Here is what a first visit costs, and what it includes.
The first appointment price, right here on the list.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: Outside the clinic, after
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length with the entrance behind you. Say how the visit went.
steps.prompter: Clean, calm and nobody rushed me, I would book the next one here.

captions.script: Clean, calm and nobody rushed me, I would book the next one here.
Would I go back? Yes, and I would book it on Loca.
